shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200
for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
ls -la && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | head -3; node -v; npm -v
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep '"version"' && ls && ls build | head -50 && find . -path '*toaster*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components | head -80; echo ---; cat components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ---; grep -rl "ToasterProvider\|useToaster" --include=*.d.ts . | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat toaster-singleton.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js; echo ---; cat components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js; echo ---; grep -rn "autoHiding" components/Toaster --include=*.js | head; echo ---; grep -rn "toaster" index.js | head

grep -n "DEFAULT_TIMEOUT" components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head -3; grep -rn "toaster-singleton" --include=*.js . | head -5; grep -n "Button" components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls components/Button; grep -n "view\|size" components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
rm -rf dist && which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^playwright|puppeteer" ; echo done
